content:
Context: Working notes for the weekly Zenith Health private deployment sync. This is a prep + capture doc for the Redwood internal and customer-facing weekly meeting. Focus this week: finalize VPC/subnet plan, unblock on-prem node provisioning, and lock KMS integration steps.

Notes from quick status round:
- Zenith: Rina confirms procurement is chasing vendor; waiting on shipment ETA. Procurement expects update mid-week.
- NetEng (Samir): Need subnet/CIDR decision to proceed with firewall rules and peering. Provided initial overlapping ranges that conflict with existing Zenith campus.
- Redwood SRE (Miguel): Bootstrap scripts failing on new vendor image in 2 places (ssh key perms, systemd unit race), working on fixes.
- Redwood SE (Asha): Network design doc updated with new CIDR options, still awaiting customer selection.

Risks: If vendor shipment slips >5 business days, M2 will slip and can cascade to canary deploy date. CIDR delay will block firewall and peering tests and could push KMS smoke tests.

Follow-ups / notes: Keep daily sync via slack channel #zenith-private to move fast on the CIDR decision. If procurement confirms vendor ETA remains >2026-06-22, trigger contingency plan: fallback to small initial canary on cloud-hosted dedicated instead of full on-prem.

Prep for next meeting: Bring finalized CIDR options (Asha), vendor ETA confirmation (Jordan & Rina), and a one-page summary of bootstrap script fixes (Miguel).

Meeting wrap: Confirmed next weekly sync 2026-06-22 10:00 PDT. Triage session to be scheduled on 2026-06-18 15:00 PDT if CIDR not approved.
